chicken.definition: Meat from a chicken, sold as a whole bird or in cuts.
chicken.exampleUsage: The chicken was identified during the lesson.

turkey.definition: Meat from a turkey, sold as a whole bird or in cuts.
turkey.exampleUsage: The turkey was identified during the lesson.

duck.definition: Flesh of a duck (domestic or wild).

goose.definition: Flesh of a goose (domestic or wild).

quail.definition: A small game bird sometimes raised for its meat and eggs.

chicken-breast.definition: Meat from the front part of a chicken's body.

drumstick.definition: The lower joint of the leg of a fowl.
drumstick.exampleUsage: The glossary uses the term "Drumstick" in an educational description.

wing.definition: A poultry wing sold or served as a cut of meat.

thigh.definition: The upper part of a poultry leg, sold as a cut of meat.

ground-turkey.definition: Turkey meat that has been finely chopped or minced.
ground-turkey.exampleUsage: The recipe used cooked ground turkey in the filling.

pork.definition: Meat from a domestic hog or pig.

veal.definition: Meat from a young calf, used as food.

steak.definition: A slice of meat cut from the fleshy part of an animal or large fish.
steak.exampleUsage: The steak was identified during the lesson.

roast.definition: A large cut of meat intended for cooking with dry heat.

ground-beef.definition: Beef processed into very small pieces for use in cooking.

ribs.definition: Cut of meat including one or more ribs.

tenderloin.definition: The tender meat of the loin muscle on each side of the vertebral column.

brisket.definition: A cut of meat from the breast or lower chest especially of beef.

salmon.definition: A fish with pink or orange flesh, often eaten as food.

tuna.definition: Meat from a large sea fish, commonly sold fresh or canned.

cod.definition: A sea fish with white flesh, often eaten as food.

shrimp.exampleUsage: The shrimp was identified during the lesson.
shrimp.definition: A small sea animal with a curved body, many legs, and a hard shell.

lobster.definition: A large sea animal with a hard shell and two strong claws.

crab.definition: A shellfish with a hard shell and claws, sold as food.

oyster.definition: Marine mollusks having a rough irregular shell.

mussel.definition: An edible shellfish with two dark elongated shells.

clam.definition: Burrowing marine mollusk living on sand or mud.

scallop.definition: A shellfish with a fan-shaped shell.

bacon.definition: Thin slices of cured pork, often fried before eating.

sausage.definition: Highly seasoned minced meat stuffed in casings.

ham.definition: Pork from a pig's hind leg, usually cured or cooked.

salami.definition: A cured sausage, often sliced and eaten cold.

prosciutto.definition: Italian salt-cured ham usually sliced paper thin.

pepperoni.definition: A pork and beef sausage (or a thin slice of this sausage).

hot-dog.definition: A cooked sausage, often served in a long split bread roll.
hot-dog.exampleUsage: The food stand served a hot dog with a side salad.

pastrami.definition: Highly seasoned cut of smoked beef.

fillet.definition: A boneless portion of meat or fish.
fillet.arabicTranslation: قطعة لحم أو سمك بلا عظم

chop.definition: A cut of meat with a bone, usually from the rib or loin.

cutlet.definition: Thin slice of meat (especially veal) usually fried or broiled.

medallion.definition: A circular helping of food (especially a boneless cut of meat).

shank.definition: A cut of meat from the lower part of an animal's leg.

loin.definition: A cut of meat taken from the side and back of an animal between the ribs and the rump.
loin.exampleUsage: The loin was identified during the lesson.

rack.definition: Rib section of a forequarter of veal or pork or especially lamb or mutton.

ground.definition: Broken into very small pieces, as in ground meat.
